draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the unseen test set of the Banking and Travel domains it was trained on (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9 macro-F1).
rationale: Evidence only covers the unseen test set of the trained domains (Banking, Travel). No evaluation on other customer-service domains exists, so generalization to unseen domains is unsupported. The hedged "may" does not rescue it; the claim's proposition is about domains not seen in training, which was never tested.
